gloss: rookie of the year; best newcomer

definitions.gloss: rookie of the year; best newcomer
definitions.explanation: An award given to the most outstanding first-year player or newcomer in a sport, league, or other competitive field.

examples.japanese: {新人王|しんじんおう}を{獲得|かくとく}した。
examples.english: He won the rookie of the year award.

examples.japanese: {新人王|しんじんおう}の{最有力|さいゆうりょく}{候補|こうほ}と{言|い}われている。
examples.english: He is said to be the strongest candidate for rookie of the year.

examples.japanese: プロ{野球|やきゅう}の{新人王|しんじんおう}はセ・リーグとパ・リーグで{一人|ひとり}ずつ{選|えら}ばれる。
examples.english: One rookie of the year is selected from each of the Central and Pacific Leagues in professional baseball.

notes:
USAGE:
Award commonly given in professional sports (baseball, soccer, sumo, boxing) and sometimes in entertainment or business. In Japanese professional baseball, it is formally called the {最優秀|さいゆうしゅう}{新人|しんじん} award.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新人王|しんじんおう}を{獲得|かくとく}する (to win the rookie award)
- {新人王|しんじんおう}{候補|こうほ} (rookie of the year candidate)
- {新人王|しんじんおう}{争|あらそ}い (race for the rookie award)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {得点王|とくてんおう}: top scorer — the highest-scoring player in a league
